notes.matooke: Mu Lungereza lwa Uganda abantu era bagamba “matooke”.
notes.nnina: “I have”. Naye enjala n’enyonta bya njawulo: “I am hungry”, “I am thirsty”.
notes.enjala: Mu Lungereza ogamba “I am hungry”, si “I have hunger”.

guidebook.intro: Emere n’akatale: manya emere eya bulidho mu Lungereza, gamba ti olumwa enjala oba enyonta, era ogule n’okutunda.

tips.title: “I am hungry”
body: Mu Lusoga ogamba **Nina enjala**, kwe kugamba “nina” enjala. Mu Lungereza tegamba bw’otyo: ogamba **I am hungry** ne **I am thirsty**.
Kino kikola ne ku birala bingi: **I am sick**, **I am happy**.

tips.title: “I eat” oba “I am eating”
body: Mu Lusoga **Ndya** kiyinza okutegeeza ti olya atyanu oba ti olya bulidho. Mu Lungereza bya njawulo:
**I eat matooke** = ndya matooke (bulidho). **I am eating matooke** = ndya matooke atyanu atyanu. Mu katale, **I am buying** kitegeeza ti ogula atyanu.

culture.title: Ebigambo bya Uganda mu Lungereza
body: Mu Uganda, Olungereza lukozesa ebigambo by’emere eby’ewaka: **matooke**, **posho**, **rolex** (chapati ne magi). Abagenyi babiyiga mangu, kale tobitya.
